subject: Film & Cinema
title: Martin Scorsese: Street-Level Genius
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Martin Scorsese: Street-Level Genius.

hook.text: Scorsese grew up watching gangsters from his apartment window. Then he filmed their stories.

buildup.text: Taxi Driver, Goodfellas, and Raging Bull explored violence, guilt, and redemption.

discovery.text: His kinetic camera work and music choices created a visceral, immersive style.

twist.text: It took him over 20 years and five nominations to finally win the Best Director Oscar.

climax.text: At 80+, he's still making films and fighting for cinema as an art form.

punchline.text: He films the streets that raised him.

quiz.question: What themes does Scorsese's filmography frequently explore?
